violations.why: irq_husk (higher priority) can preempt irq_urchin after v_wharf++ and set v_wharf=1, so urchin reads a different value than it wrote.
irq_husk can write v_wharf between urchin's read and its later write of 0, so the husk write is overwritten.
The v_lagoon++ in urchin is a non-atomic read-modify-write. Husk's write of 1 can land in between and be lost.
Husk can set v_inlet=1 between urchin's use of v_inlet as the array index and its increment. The index and the increment then use different values.
The v_inlet++ in urchin is a non-atomic read-modify-write. Husk's write of 1 can be overwritten.
